title: New Patient Registration Intake Form
subtitle: Capture demographics source, contact, representative authority, and privacy acknowledgment; confirm chart match and visit handoff.
description: New Patient Registration records demographics source, contact, representative authority, privacy acknowledgment, chart match, and visit handoff. New Patient Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this new patient registration structured intake when staff must document demographics source and contact. Reconcile representative authority, privacy acknowledgment, chart match, and visit handoff before the new patient registration handoff. Use registration source documents, demographic confirmation, representative authority, privacy notice receipt, duplicate-record result, communication preference, and check-in handoff. This registration centers chart creation, demographic confirmation, representative authority, communication preference, privacy receipt, duplicate-record prevention, guarantor routing, and front-desk arrival. Ask the assigned new patient registration reviewer to confirm demographics source against the organization's policy.
